root_cause: The OpenVINO export of the GPTQ-quantized OPT-125M model (katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq) produces logits that deviate from the PyTorch reference by up to 0.069, exceeding the test tolerance threshold. The model uses 4-bit GPTQ quantization (GPT-QModel 6.0.3, Transformers 5.5.3, Torch 2.12.0+cpu). The accuracy discrepancy indicates a numerical precision issue in the PyTorch frontend's handling of the GPTQ TorchFusedQuantLinear kernel during export mode conversion.
recommended_actions: Investigate the GPTQ dequantization path in the PyTorch FX decoder to find the source of ~0.069 max diff in OPT-GPTQ models
Check if the PR changes to the PyTorch frontend or GPTQ handling introduced a regression in quantized model accuracy
Review test_llm.py compare_results tolerance thresholds for GPTQ models with TorchFusedQuantLinear
Add debug logging comparing intermediate tensor values to isolate which layer introduces the diff
prevention_strategies: Ensure GPTQ quantized model tests run on both convert and export modes before merging changes to the PyTorch frontend. Add stricter CI coverage for quantized model accuracy.
